module: Career reaction to speed traps (gameplay_speedTraps): fines for speeding and running red lights, UI messages, flash sound, and recording into the speed trap leaderboards (gameplay_speedTrapLeaderboards) saved in <save>/career/speedTrapLeaderboards/. Only the player's vehicle (index 0) is concerned.
notes: Speeding fine (overSpeed in m/s): <= 6.7056 m/s (15 mph) 35; <= 11.176 m/s (25 mph) 70; beyond that 100. It is paid with canBeNegative = true (the balance can become negative).

Penalty type: vehicle outside the inventory or owned with a plate (part whose name contains "licenseplate") = normal fine; without a plate = message without a fine; loaned "work" type vehicle with a plate = loss of 10 reputation points of the owning organization. A non-owned, non-"work" vehicle with a plate receives no penalty (penaltyType nil).
Red light: fixed fine of 500 if the vehicle is outside the inventory or has a plate; otherwise only a message.
Whatever the outcome, onSpeedTrapTriggered adds a record to the leaderboard and displays a message (new record, record with no previous one, or no new record).

onSpeedTrapTriggered.desc: Hook called when a speed trap triggers: applies the fine or penalty depending on the plate and vehicle type, then updates the speed trap's leaderboard.

overSpeed.desc: Excess over the limit in m/s.

onRedLightCamTriggered.desc: Hook called when a red light camera triggers: fine of 500 with message and sound if the player's vehicle is identifiable by a plate.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook: loads the profile's speed trap leaderboards if the career is active (returns false otherwise).

onSaveCurrentProfile.desc: Save hook: writes the speed trap leaderboards to career/speedTrapLeaderboards/.
